result.instructions: Tools for Speechmatics, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Speechmatics data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run speechmatics_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run speechmatics_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run speechmatics_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. speechmatics_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: speechmatics_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List transcription jobs (most recent first), with status/data_name/duration. Batch API: GET /jobs.

created_before.description: RFC3339 date-time; only return jobs created before this time (for pagination).

include_deleted.description: Include deleted jobs in the results.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: Get a single job's details and status (running | done | rejected | deleted | expired). Poll this until status is "done", then fetch the transcript. Batch API: GET /jobs/{job_id}.

job_id.description: The job id returned by speechmatics_transcribe_url.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_transcript
tools.title: Get transcript
tools.description: Get a completed job's transcript. format=txt (default, human-readable) | srt (subtitles) | json-v2 (structured words, timings, speakers, translations, summary). Only works once the job status is "done". Batch API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/transcript.

format.description: Output format. Default txt for readability; use json-v2 for structured results.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_job_log
tools.title: Get job log
tools.description: Get a job's plain-text processing log — useful for debugging a rejected job. Batch API: GET /jobs/{job_id}/log.

tools.name: speechmatics_get_usage
tools.title: Get usage
tools.description: Get usage statistics (transcription minutes) for the account over a date range. Batch API: GET /usage.

tools.name: speechmatics_transcribe_url
tools.title: Transcribe audio/video from URL
tools.description: Submit a publicly reachable audio/video URL for speech-to-text transcription (optionally with diarization, translation, and summarization). ASYNC: returns a job id immediately — poll speechmatics_get_job until status is "done", then call speechmatics_get_transcript. Batch API: POST /jobs.

url.description: Publicly reachable audio/video URL for Speechmatics to fetch and transcribe.

language.description: Transcription language code, e.g. en, es, de, fr.

operating_point.description: Accuracy/speed tradeoff. enhanced is more accurate; standard is faster/cheaper.

diarization.description: Speaker labeling: speaker (who spoke) | channel (per audio channel) | none.

output_locale.description: Output spelling locale, e.g. en-US, en-GB.

enable_entities.description: Emit formatted entities (numbers, dates) in results.

additional_vocab.description: Custom vocabulary — strings, or objects like {"content":"gnocchi","sounds_like":["nyohki"]}.

translation_target_languages.description: Language codes to also translate the transcript into, e.g. ["es","de"].

summarize.description: If true, also produce a summary of the transcript.

fetch_auth_headers.description: Auth headers to send when fetching a private URL, e.g. ["Authorization: Bearer xyz"].

notification_url.description: Webhook URL to POST the transcript to when the job completes.

tools.name: speechmatics_delete_job
tools.title: Delete job
tools.description: ⚠️ Permanently deletes a job and its transcript. Set force=true to delete even while it is still running. Batch API: DELETE /jobs/{job_id}.

force.description: Delete even if the job is still running.
